a.lede: PARTNER CONTENT: AI agents are making security vulnerabilities easier to find and exploit in your code. Software engineering and application security teams need new ways to find and fix them
a.title: Has AI’s ‘Black October’ changed the way you secure your code?

b.lede: An AI agent built to automate invoice processing could be manipulated into changing vendor bank details through a malicious email, without triggering traditional security alerts. Token Security examines five critical AI agent security gaps and shares practical guidance from industry security leaders on preventing them. [...]
b.title: How one AI agent exposed five critical enterprise security gaps
